I can't apply this skill to your offering — it's out of scope.

**Why:** Intelligent Clay productizes *services* (consulting, coaching, done-for-you work) by decomposing time, access, and deliverables into configurable atoms. A handmade leather wallet is a physical product. It's already a discrete SKU — there's nothing to atomize in the service sense.

**What you likely want instead — SKU/bundle logic:**

The right frame for a physical product line is **variant + bundle architecture**, not service modularization. The dimensions look similar on the surface but behave differently:

- **Variants** — leather type (vegetable-tanned, chromexcel, shell cordovan), color, stitch color, card-slot count, monogramming
- **Form factors** — bifold, cardholder, long wallet, money clip, zip pouch
- **Tiers via materials, not scope** — entry (standard leather) / signature ($120 current) / heirloom (premium hide, hand-stitched)
- **Bundles** — wallet + cardholder, wallet + belt, his/hers sets, gift sets
- **Add-ons** — monogram, gift box, extended warranty, repair/recondition service

The pricing logic here is cost-of-goods + perceived-craft premium, not anchored-against-flagship-service logic. Different skill, different structure.

**One genuine overlap:** if you offer **custom/bespoke commissions** (customer picks hide, dimensions, interior layout), *that* portion is a service and could be modularized — consultation call, design iterations, revision count, turnaround speed. If that's a real part of your business, tell me more and I'll apply the skill to the bespoke track.

Otherwise, you want a product-line / merchandising framework, not this one.

You get the full method, no hand-holding. | Free. Anchor: ecosystem adoption + top-of-funnel for paid tiers. The skill itself is the lead magnet. |
| **Core — Operator** *(flagship)* | MIT or co-branded · 1 vertical pack · Priority 24hr support · Hosted memory + dashboard · Full exporter suite · 1 seat · Feature requests queue | For consultants/coaches running productization for themselves AND for 2–5 clients/year. Vertical benchmarks + saved runs across engagements. | +$B/yr. Anchor: cost of one botched productization engagement (~$10–50K in misaligned pricing). Flagship should price well below that. |
| **Premium — Agency** | White-label + resale · All vertical packs + 1 custom pack built w/ user · Dedicated Slack same-day · Hosted memory + multi-client dashboard · All exporters + custom schemas · Unlimited seats · Named roadmap input · Quarterly workshops | For agencies and consulting firms running productization as a repeatable service line for clients. Resell the output under your own brand. | +$C/yr. Anchor: 1–2 billable productization engagements/yr covers it; everything after is margin. Priced below hiring an in-house productization lead. |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** Free (Lite baseline) — but BYO starts accruing as soon as any paid dimension is selected.
- **Per-dimension upgrade pricing** (tokens; re-anchor once buyer is named):
  - White-label branding: `+$W/yr`
  - Each additional vertical pack beyond the first: `+$V/yr`
  - Support upgrade (Email → Priority): `+$S1/yr`; (Priority → Dedicated): `+$S2/yr`
  - Hosted memory + dashboard: `+$M/yr`
  - Advanced exporters: `+$E/yr`
  - Each additional seat beyond 1: `+$P/seat/yr`
  - Co-development (feature queue): `+$R1/yr`; (named roadmap input): `+$R2/yr`
  - Custom vertical pack (one-time): `+$CP`
- **Floor:** Any single paid upgrade (otherwise stay on Lite).
- **Ceiling:** If BYO sum exceeds ~80% of Premium price, OR user selects white-label + hosted memory + 3+ seats, auto-route to Premium.
- **Configurator dependencies to enforce:** all seven "invalid combinations" above.
- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO sum to replicate Core (1 vertical pack + priority support + hosted memory + full exporters) must exceed Core's `+$B/yr` price. BYO sum to replicate Premium (white-label + all packs + custom pack + dedicated support + unlimited seats + named roadmap) must exceed Premium's `+$C/yr`. Flagships remain the rational discount; BYO is for buyers whose needs genuinely don't match a tier shape.
